purpose: Machine-readable current-state SNAPSHOT for menqstudio/OS. sync.live_main_resolution: Resolve the ACTUAL default-branch (main) HEAD from git/GitHub at session start. baseline_main_head_at_sync is only the SHA this snapshot was synced against; it becomes stale as PRs merge. On a push to main, CI requires this baseline to be an ANCESTOR of the pushed HEAD (never that a merged carrier PR stays open) — so merging the carrier PR #33 cannot make main CI red.

The repository-truth CARRIER PR is current_workflow_pr (NOT in prs[]), so merging it never leaves a recorded-open-but-merged PR.

carrier_transition.note: The carrier's transition is modeled explicitly so main is never knowingly stale. On a pull_request CI run the pre_merge state applies (carrier open, gate PR33_REAUDIT). On a push to main, check_repo_state resolves PR #33 live; if MERGED it REQUIRES this post_merge block to already be correct (gate REBASE_PR31, carrier merged, phase_0 done) — so the same merged content already declares the post-merge truth and main-push CI is GREEN without a second sync PR.
